scope: Only design.png, first six tiles of keys/revisions/board-v1.png, selected source 16-frame sheet, and selected source six-key sheet where present. No builder notes, prior critiques, or tests inspected.
inspection_method: Actual view_image inspection of every listed image.
subject: tractor
evidence: The keys become larger and the rear wheel becomes wider, but K1-K3 retain an essentially left-facing side-profile hood/wheel arrangement. Source indices 1, 3, and 5 require a clearly more frontal three-quarter approach before indices 10-11 reach the near side view.

The drawings retain the recognizable tall bent exhaust, small front wheel and large rear wheel, but hood-to-wheel proportions and the rear wheel contour are substantially reconstructed from the chosen design.
biggest_gap: The approach-to-profile change of view is not readable; size increase currently carries most of the source change.
smallest_repair: Rework only K1-K3 into progressively less foreshortened three-quarter views using the chosen doodle hood, exhaust, seat line and wheel contours as the identity constraints; keep K4-K6 as the side-view destination, restoring their original hood/wheel proportions where reconstructed. Do not add source-film detail.
must_not_be_lost: The exact irregular original rear-wheel silhouette and its overlap with the rectangular hood.
The small front wheel, bent exhaust with the downward inner stroke, rising seat/back line, and plain black-on-white doodle economy.
source_note: The available six-key sheet samples later times than the assigned interval, so the assigned 16-frame indices were the deciding pose references.
